description: This file defines the data models and protocols related to recipes in the app. It includes the Recipe struct with its coding keys, an enumeration for health labels, mock data for testing, custom error types, a protocol for recipe fetching services, and two implementations: a live network-based service and a mock service.

methods.name: fetch(matching:in:page:)
methods.description: Fetches recipes matching the query, diet, and page number, returning a publisher with a list of Recipe objects or an error.
